podStatus.title: Pod status
podStatus.empty: No live pods reported. Either the workload hasn't been deployed yet, the runtime cluster is unreachable, or the manifest declared zero replicas.
podStatus.bucketEmpty: No pod names returned for this bucket.

pods.title: Pods
pods.empty: No pods reported for this workload yet.

init.title: Init containers
init.description: Run to completion before the primary starts. Resource budget excluded from steady-state accounting.

primary.title: Primary
primary.description: The workload's main container — the row whose name matches the workload slug.
primary.empty: No primary container detected. Check the workload's container names.

sidecars.title: Sidecars
sidecars.description: Auxiliary containers (service meshes, log shippers). Their resources don't roll into the primary's budget.

containers.empty: This workload has no containers declared in the manifest and no live pods reporting either.

policies.description: Runtime predicates layered on top of RBAC.

apiTokens.title: API tokens
apiTokens.description: Long-lived bearer tokens for CLIs and bots.

cost.title: Cost
cost.description: Currency-denominated platform spend, rolled up from CostSnapshot rows. Pick a time range; the trend chart marks anomalies (> 2σ day-over-day jumps); the per-resource panel attributes spend to specific managed-service bindings.

forecast.insufficientData: Not enough daily cost data yet for a confident projection.

trend.title: Daily trend
trend.description: Per-day platform spend over the selected range. Marked points exceed the day-over-day rolling 2σ.
trend.emptyTitle: No cost data in this window
trend.emptyDescription: The daily cost collector hasn't written snapshots for the selected range yet, or the cloud-side billing API hasn't reported usage. Live pricing data only — nothing is estimated client-side.

budgets.title: Budgets
budgets.description: Budgets fire alerts as you cross each percentage threshold.
budgets.emptyDescription: Budgets can be set per organization, team, or project.

byCategory.title: By category
byCategory.description: Spend split across workload / managed-service / egress / storage / other.

attribution.title: Per-resource attribution
attribution.description: Spend broken out by managed-service binding (e.g. main_db, events_queue, uploads_bucket). Untagged rows roll up under "shared / untagged" — usually shared egress or providers that don't yet apply the platform binding tag.
attribution.emptyDescription: Bindings are visible only after the cloud-side cost driver tags resources with astrolift.io/binding at provision time. Track #432 from:backend for the provider-side rollout.
